title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：poetry　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 poetry 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the painter ① read the poetry that no visitor in the studio would have recorded, and he said the reading was the whole of the season. The ② poetry, meaning the verse itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; poetry, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of poetry in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ poetry at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Poetry, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the painter said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the poetry was the whole of the matter, meaning the beauty and not the verse. The ⑥ poetry, meaning the beauty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; poetry, he said, is either something you read or the only word that means both verse and a beauty. He said the beauty is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ poetry had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ poetry of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of recording; poetry, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ poetry I remember is the poetry recorded in the catalogue, which closed in 1988 and is still recorded as the quietest in the studio. ⑩ Poetry, my mother said in 1990, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all poetry, she said, is a beauty that has agreed to look like verse. She said the beauty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 诗歌；诗意（指画室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 诗歌；诗意（指那分诗歌本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：read the poetry 读这一分诗歌
D. n. 诗歌；诗意（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 诗歌之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的诗歌之事）
F. n. 诗歌；诗意（指展品目录里写到、被记载的那一分）
G. n. 诗歌、意境（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 意境（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: read the poetry that no visitor in the studio would have recorded
The poetry, meaning the verse itself and not the brush
Every sort of poetry in that studio
the poetry at the far easel
the poetry was the whole of the matter
the poetry had become a line in a catalogue
The poetry of the whole thing

answers.why: read the poetry 意为“读这一分诗歌”，1981 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯记载的一分诗歌做了一遍。
poetry 意为“诗歌；诗意”，指那分诗歌本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记载。
poetry 意为“诗歌；诗意”，指画室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
poetry 意为“诗歌；诗意”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
poetry 意为“诗歌、意境”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分意境就是那件事的全部。
poetry 意为“意境”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分诗歌，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
poetry 意为“诗歌；诗意”，指展品目录里写到、被记载的那一分，到 1986 年这一分成了展品目录里的一行。
poetry 意为“诗歌之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的诗歌之事是一处画室和三个季度的记载。
poetry 意为“诗歌；诗意”，我记得的是展品目录里记载过的那一分，1988 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一分。
poetry 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，诗歌是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的诗歌。
